choose_token.title: API Token Options
choose_token.description: Choose how you would like to proceed with the API token.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered Tinxy device
zeroconf_confirm.description:
A Tinxy device was found at {host} (chip {chip_id}).

Enter your Tinxy API key to match it against your account and add it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tinxy device
reconfigure.description: Update the address this device is reached at, or replace the API key. The IP is checked against the device's chip id before it is saved.

data_description.host: Local IP address of the Tinxy device

error.device_not_in_account: That device is not in the Tinxy account this API key belongs to.
error.wrong_chip_id: Another Tinxy device answered at that address. Check the IP.
error.api_not_available: The device answered but its local API is not enabled.

abort.api_not_available: The device answered but its local API is not enabled.

init.title: Tinxy Local Options
init.description: Configure advanced settings for Tinxy Local integration. The device address and API key are changed under Reconfigure.

data_description.request_timeout: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to Tinxy devices. Default is 3 seconds. Increase if you have slow network connections.
data_description.polling_interval: How often to poll devices for status updates. Default is 6 seconds. Must be greater than or equal to request timeout. Lower values provide faster updates but increase network traffic.
data_description.rate_limit_delay: Minimum gap between commands to one device. Default is 1 second, which is the fastest the device's authentication allows: its token encrypts a whole-second timestamp, so two commands in the same second cannot both be accepted. This applies per device, not per switch. Raise it if a device stops responding.

error.polling_less_than_timeout: Polling interval must be greater than or equal to request timeout
